versions.changelog: Fix: Windows Store python stub (exit 9009, near-empty stderr) was misclassified as FAIL; missing-tool failures are now correctly reported as UNVERIFIED. Verified on real Python/Go/Rust projects (tenacity, go-version, anyhow).
Initial release: deterministic exit-code verdicts (PASS/FAIL/REGRESSION/UNVERIFIED), snapshot baseline regression detection, vitest watch-trap neutralization, monorepo awareness
